description: This source file defines an abstract class for MethodOperation, which are elements in the Mini-language used by the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides the structure for executing operations within methods, including method execution logic and related annotations.

classes.name: MethodOperation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a Mini-language element model within the OFBiz framework. It provides the interface for executing operations and managing string representations.

classes.name: MethodOperation.Factory
classes.description: An interface defining a factory for creating MethodOperation instances, including methods for creation and retrieving the name.

classes.name: MethodOperation.DeprecatedOperation
classes.description: An annotation indicating deprecated operations within MethodOperation classes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, returning true to continue script execution or false to stop, with potential to throw a MiniLangException.

methods.name: expandedString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the operation by expanding variables within its toString() output, using the current method context environment map. Deprecated.

methods.name: rawString
methods.description: Returns a string representation similar to the original XML. Deprecated; use toString() instead.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of a MethodOperation given an XML Element and SimpleMethod.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the factory, indicating the type of MethodOperation it creates.
